title: End-of-Support for VMware vSphere Hypervisor (ESXi) Version 5.5

blocks.text: Zscaler will no longer support ESXi version 5.5 after December 24, 2024. Customers currently using ESXi version 5.5 will need to use ESXi version 7.0 Update 2 or later after this date.
If you need help upgrading to ESXi 7.0 Update 2 or later, or if you have additional questions or concerns, contact Zscaler Support.
